description: Check a finalized proof: metadata consistency, the exact 128-byte memo, and the Ed25519 service signature against the published key registry. The response also contains the exact Solana RPC call and expectations so the caller can independently confirm the transaction on chain, because this hosted check is performed by the Verifyum service itself. A finalized Verifyum anchor demonstrates that a commitment to exact file bytes existed no later than the estimated Solana block time. It does not prove authorship, ownership, legal signature validity, when the file was first created, or whether statements inside the file are true.
name: verifyum_verify_public_proof
title: Verify a public Verifyum proof
